title: A graded linear equivalence compares Proj sheaves supplied by fraction charts
statement: Let k be a field, S=k[x₀,x₁], and P=Proj S [def-nagata-affine-proj]. Let M,N be S-modules and let G_n⊆M,H_n⊆N be arbitrary sets indexed by n≥0. Let e:M≃_S N be a linear equivalence such that y∈G_n iff e(y)∈H_n. Let F,G be O_P-module sheaves. On every D₊(f) for homogeneous f of positive degree, assume additive injections alpha_f:F(D₊(f))→M_f and beta_f:G(D₊(f))→N_f whose images are the equal-degree fractions [def-sc-degree-zero-module-fractions] with numerators in G_n and H_n respectively. Both chart maps respect scalars via awayToSection and algebraMap to S_f. Both obey the restriction formula y/f^m↦a^m y/g^(e m) for every homogeneous relation g^e=af, e>0, and inclusion D₊(g)⊆D₊(f). Then F and G are isomorphic. No internal grading, finite basis, twists or stalk maps are assumed.

proof.text: Localize the given linear equivalence with IsLocalizedModule.mapEquiv. Its fraction formula is LocalizedModule.map_mk. The numerator-degree hypothesis identifies the two chart ranges. Invert the injective beta chart onto its range and compose with the localized equivalence and alpha to obtain additive section maps. Prove them bijective using the inverse localized equivalence and the range equality.

Proj.basicOpenIsoAway makes awayToSection surjective. Apply injectivity of beta to the scalar equation for the section map; the supplied scalar equations and linearity of the localized equivalence prove it. Thus obtain linear equivalences of section modules.

For a standard-open inclusion obtain a homogeneous relation g^e=af using standardOpenProperties. Every alpha-image has a fraction representative with denominator a power of f by its range equality. Apply both supplied restriction formulas and e(a^m • y)=a^m • e(y) to prove restriction compatibility of the linear equivalences.

The same standardOpenProperties gives the positive homogeneous standard-open basis, intersections via multiplication, and finite refinements. Restrict F to this basis. Its finite gluing follows from TopCat.Sheaf.existsUnique_gluing'. Apply exists_sheafOfModules_from_basis and its uniqueness clause twice: once with the identity chart identifications for F, once with the inverse local equivalences for G. Compose the resulting isomorphisms E≅F and E≅G to obtain F≅G.

theorem graded_chart_comparison (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (M N : ModuleCat.{u} (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k))
    (𝓜 : ℕ → Set M) (𝓝 : ℕ → Set N)
    (e : M ≃ₗ[MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k] N)
    (hdegree : ∀ (n : ℕ) (y : M), y ∈ 𝓜 n ↔ e y ∈ 𝓝 n)
    (F G : (Proj (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k)).Modules)
    (alpha : ∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d : ℕ),
      0 < d → f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d →
      F.val.obj (op (basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)) →+
        LocalizedModule.Away f M)
    (halpha : ∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
        (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d),
        Function.Injective (alpha f d hd hf) ∧
        Set.range (alpha f d hd hf) = degreeZeroFractions
          (fun n : ℕ ↦ (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k n : Set (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)))
          (fun n : ℕ ↦ 𝓜 n) (Submonoid.powers f))
    (hscalar : ∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
        (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d)
        (r : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)
        (s : F.val.obj (op (basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f))),
        alpha f d hd hf (awayToSection (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f r • s) =
          algebraMap (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)
            (Localization.Away f) r • alpha f d hd hf s)
    (hres : ∀ (f g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d b : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hb : 0 < b)
        (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d)
        (hg : g ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k b)
        (inc : basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) g ≤
          basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)
        (e c : ℕ) (a : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k),
        0 < e → a ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k c → g ^ e = a * f →
        ∀ (m : ℕ) (y : M)
          (s : F.val.obj (op (basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f))),
          alpha f d hd hf s = mk y (⟨f ^ m, ⟨m, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers f) →
          alpha g b hb hg (F.val.map (homOfLE inc).op s) =
            mk (a ^ m • y) (⟨g ^ (e * m), ⟨e * m, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers g))
    (beta : ∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d : ℕ),
      0 < d → f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d →
      G.val.obj (op (basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)) →+
        LocalizedModule.Away f N)
    (hbeta : ∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
        (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d),
        Function.Injective (beta f d hd hf) ∧
        Set.range (beta f d hd hf) = degreeZeroFractions
          (fun n : ℕ ↦ (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k n : Set (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)))
          (fun n : ℕ ↦ 𝓝 n) (Submonoid.powers f))
    (hbetaScalar : ∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
        (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d)
        (r : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)
        (s : G.val.obj (op (basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f))),
        beta f d hd hf (awayToSection (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f r • s) =
          algebraMap (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)
            (Localization.Away f) r • beta f d hd hf s)
    (hbetaRes : ∀ (f g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d b : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hb : 0 < b)
        (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d)
        (hg : g ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k b)
        (inc : basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) g ≤
          basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)
        (e c : ℕ) (a : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k),
        0 < e → a ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k c → g ^ e = a * f →
        ∀ (m : ℕ) (y : N)
          (s : G.val.obj (op (basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f))),
          beta f d hd hf s = mk y (⟨f ^ m, ⟨m, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers f) →
          beta g b hb hg (G.val.map (homOfLE inc).op s) =
            mk (a ^ m • y) (⟨g ^ (e * m), ⟨e * m, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers g))
    : Nonempty (F ≅ G)
